plan.selection: All available H.R. 1–50 and S. 1–50 in each of the 118th and 119th Congresses. Numbered ranges are a deliberately bounded, nonrandom sample; reserved or unavailable numbers are recorded separately. Early-numbered bills can overrepresent leadership priorities. Not Congress-wide topic success rates. Congresses have different follow-up lengths.
